<details>
<summary><b>🔍 View Project Architectural Summaries</b></summary>
<br>

* **Amaraalaya Yoga Studio:** Full-stack yoga studio platform with dynamic website management, backend REST APIs, student CRM, course enrollments, quiz modules, blogs, and administrative management.
* **Bella Spot Parlour:** Responsive beauty parlour web application with services and packages catalogue, booking management, REST API integration, and custom administrative management panel.
* **Task Management System:** Multi-tier workflow system structuring organization, team, project, and task flows with Laravel Sanctum authentication, role-based access control, CRUD operations, and Postman-tested REST APIs.
* **Nila Tiles:** Commercial showroom web application ([nilatiles.in](https://nilatiles.in/)) featuring dynamic product categories, product filtering, mobile UI, and SEO-optimized React components.
* **Ram Prabha Builders:** Construction business enterprise site built with responsive business-oriented layouts, React components, and Tailwind CSS.
* **Smart Canteen Pre-Order System:** Flutter + Firebase college canteen mobile application featuring student authentication, digital order flows, token generation, and real-time database management.

</details>
